verdict: E - Infrastructure/data limitations prevent valid interpretation
executive_summary: Phase 12B attempted to test whether point-in-time fundamental information provides predictive evidence beyond OHLCV features. All fundamental feature sets were blocked because synthetic fundamental data has filing dates (1998-2013) that predate the trade date start (1996), violating PIT compliance. Only baseline OHLCV experiments (FS-12B-A) were executed, yielding ICs consistent with noise.
